v13_note: V13, the taper-direction sign test (RC8; provenance/rc7_traces/code/taper_sign.py): PASS when the image's outer-width slope along the leg has the mask's sign beyond 3 SE with coverage >= 0.5, >= 30 positions and a mask slope of at least 1e-4 um/um; FAIL at the opposite sign; else INCONCLUSIVE.  The SE is the larger of the Newey-West SE (Bartlett kernel, lag 100 um, beyond two row pitches) and the independent-sample SE: neighbouring positions share pixels and their residuals are autocorrelated, so the independent-sample SE alone is too small (RC8 code review, M1, N2).  A sign test: the magnitude ratio is reported, not judged.  The wall window must exceed the largest wall offset (review 3, E6; the code review, m3): +-30 um on the neighbouring leg (the nested reading's walls lie 16.3-19.6 um outside the mask's, offset_abs_range_um), +-12 um on leg 4's array part.  Required: aligned leg4 PASS, aligned neighbour PASS, fold20 leg4 PASS, pathorder leg4 PASS, pathorder neighbour FAIL, rc7 leg4 PASS, start51 leg4 PASS.
